title: Generative AI is a Parasitic Cancer
summary: Freya Holmer delivers a long critique of generative AI, arguing it degrades the internet by flooding it with machine-generated junk. The video grew out of her frustration finding reliable information about a technical file format.
why: HN people link it when discussing AI-generated spam clogging search results and the broader harm of generative AI to the web.

quote.text: She talks at length about how pages of AI-generated nonsense text are cluttering search results on Google and all other search engines.
